title: Check a startup or connection problem safely

summary.text: Use the visible status information to describe a startup problem before trying disruptive repairs.

problem.text: Daedalus will not open black blank white screen connecting to network node crashed

symptoms.text: Daedalus will not open black blank white screen connecting to network node crashed

user_phrases.text: Daedalus will not open black blank white screen connecting to network node crashed

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: If the interface opens, inspect Diagnostics and note whether the node is running, connected and in sync.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Record the exact error and your application and operating-system versions. If the interface never opens, describe what appears when launching it.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Contact support when the cause is unclear. Do not disable antivirus, reset state or remove directories based only on an old troubleshooting article.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: Staff receives a specific symptom and environment. A stopped node, clock warning or blank screen needs diagnosis; this guide does not promise a repair.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Use the genuine application and keep private backups private.
consequences: Changing or approving wallet operations can affect funds.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Conservative source-reviewed introduction; not an exhaustive troubleshooting procedure.
